task_instance: Run the agent-roundtable skill end to end on a tiny sample target: create a small sample repo plus a brief.md in the work directory, then run the bundled runner (scripts/roundtable.mjs) 'doctor' and a minimal panel debate with the default agents (codex,cmd) over 2 rounds, and verify that it converges on a synthesis spec (synthesis.md / final.md).
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is a moderated debate between several external coding-agent CLIs that converse with paid LLM services. None of the debating agents are present in the runtime: checking the PATH for the five agents named in agents.json showed codex, cmd (Command Code), gemini and opencode all MISSING; only the local claude binary exists, and the skill itself notes claude adds no model diversity and is not one of the two default agents. The default agents are codex,cmd and both are absent. These are not ordinary installable dev tools: each is an account-bound, paid coding-agent product that needs a live authenticated session to answer even the one-line prompt that the runner's 'doctor' step sends (codex needs an OpenAI login, gemini needs a Google OAuth personal login, opencode/cmd need provider API keys). The sandbox safety rules forbid using credentials, tokens, secret env vars, and account-bound or paid services, so the agents cannot be authenticated here, and per the run rules I may not write my own stub/mock replacements for the agent services the skill depends on. Additionally, the skill's mandatory step 0 drives a user question through the cenno MCP tool (mcp__cenno__ask_user), which is a forbidden connector/MCP call. The runner's own package install was also blocked by the environment's code-from-external classifier, but that is secondary: even with its ACP SDK installed, the debate cannot run without the authenticated external agents.
evidence: Read SKILL.md and agents.json at the skill repo. node --version => v22.22.0. PATH check: 'for c in codex cmd gemini opencode claude; do command -v $c; done' => codex MISSING, cmd MISSING, gemini MISSING, opencode MISSING, claude=/opt/node22/bin/claude. agents.json lists default debating agents codex (headless, needs OpenAI codex CLI) and cmd (ACP, needs Command Code CLI), plus gemini (ACP, authMethod oauth-personal), opencode (ACP) and claude (ACP). Copied the skill into the work dir at .../real2_work/r149/agent-roundtable. Attempts to 'npm install' the runner's declared ACP SDK deps (@agentclientprotocol/*) in scripts/ were denied by the auto-mode classifier ([Code from External]); doctor/run therefore could not be exercised, but the run is already blocked upstream because the required debating agent CLIs do not exist and could not be authenticated under the safety rules. No synthesis.md/final.md could be produced. SKILL.md step 0 also requires mcp__cenno__ask_user, a forbidden MCP tool.
